primaryAssumptions.status: declared simulator assumptions, not owner-selected protocol replacements
primaryAssumptions.constructorOption: invitationLimit: { P, b }; null retains the unmodified default
primaryAssumptions.firstUse: No initial P wait; first use when the unchanged identity/support gates and exact b matured sources permit.
primaryAssumptions.ownEmissionBanking: Retained own rights, no expiry; distinct from future calendar-permit accumulation.
primaryAssumptions.softwareControlDemand: One opportunity/day, enough for bounded requested arms; recipients not admitted;0 has no finite capacity measurement.

parameters.P: minimum days between creator invitations, cooldown after use keyed by SubjectId
parameters.b: own matured FACY burned per invitation

ownerQuestion.prior: max undetected growth per node ~ min(1/P, E/b)
ownerQuestion.H6: The burn adds protection only where b >= P*E, or where fake nodes earn less net than honest ones (fresh-media cost c_f, falling price). At b = 1 it is a tax on honest users without effect on farms.
ownerQuestion.providedFalsifier: at b = 1, hybrid and B are indistinguishable on fraud premium, Td/Tdbl and cluster growth, while honest growth is slower under H. Report the honest-cost increase explicitly.

interpretation.EUnit: own eligible matured FACY/day, not token price or uncalibrated private utility
interpretation.capacityNotGrowth: The min bound is an asymptotic invitation service-capacity prior under stated funding and demand, not a theorem for accepted-node growth or population doubling.
interpretation.zeroBurn: Primary b=0 requires no own Self-ID/right and consumes no source; existing identity/support and invitation freeze remain. claim_requires belongs to a separately specified secondary sweep.
interpretation.unrestrictedArm: 0 has no P/b capacity bound; software limits are censors, not demonstrated economic protection.
interpretation.threshold: b=P*E is co-binding. Strict monetary reduction below cooldown capacity requires b>P*E; equality can affect startup and phase.
interpretation.capacityVersusReturn: A nonbinding burn still consumes FACY and may affect private return. Equal invitation capacity does not prove equal fraud premium; nominal remaining emission E-b*r is not itself calibrated private utility.
interpretation.providedFalsifierLogic: The supplied b=1 pattern supports the no-farm-benefit/honest-tax subclaim. Retained verbatim, not registered as its falsifier.
interpretation.actualBaseline: The unchanged default burns one retained matured right without an independent invitation cooldown. Experimental invitationLimit={P:1,b:1} now implements the requested A explicitly, not as a silent default migration.

unboundBeforeCapture: Population-study bootstrap/initial-stock and finite opportunity/work conditions, distinct from the specified single-creator software controls.
Secondary meanings and parameterizations of accumulate, claim_requires and lapse; separate invitation permits from retained own FACY.
Calendar epoch, first permit, claiming and carry/lapse semantics for secondary arms.
Fraud-premium definition and units, honest-growth/cost endpoints and individual versus coalition accounting; distinguish growth protection from cash/utility effects.
Horizon, attention/work/evidence/merits, strategies, actor costs and any private-price model; no hidden evaluator labels in defenses.
Equivalence margins for indistinguishability, detection/doubling censoring, seed sampling and confirmation claims/ablations/named alternatives.
Implementation and method commit before fresh sampling; registered mechanism confirmation before reserved labels.
